oe_cul2_act_toggle_bilingual_chancellery = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_government_generic

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			any_accepted_culture = {
				count >= 2
			}
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			in_civil_war = no
			any_accepted_culture = {
				count >= 3
			}
			OR = {
				has_policy = oe_cul_policy_imperial_cosmopolitanism
				has_policy = oe_cul_policy_scholarly_syncretism
				has_policy = oe_cul_policy_federated_millet
				has_estate_privilege = estate_privilege:oe_cul2_priv_translation_bureau
			}
			NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_cul2_chancellery_cd }
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_cul2_chancellery_cd
		years = 5
	}

	price = price:oe_cul2_chancellery_price

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 24
	automation_tick = never

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_cul2_bilingual_chancellery_on }
				remove_variable = oe_cul2_bilingual_chancellery_on
				custom_tooltip = oe_cul2_bilingual_chancellery_disabled_tt
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = oe_cul2_bilingual_chancellery_on
				culture = {
					add_cultural_influence = 2
				}
				custom_tooltip = oe_cul2_bilingual_chancellery_enabled_tt
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_cul2_bilingual_chancellery_on }
					any_accepted_culture = { count >= 3 }
					gold >= 200
				}
			}
			add = 18
		}
	}
}

oe_cul2_act_patronize_lexicon_translation = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_government_generic

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			OR = {
				any_accepted_culture = { count >= 1 }
				country_rank_level >= 3
				has_estate_privilege = estate_privilege:oe_cul2_priv_translation_bureau
			}
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			in_civil_war = no
			NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_cul2_lexicon_cd }
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_cul2_lexicon_cd
		years = 10
	}

	price = price:oe_cul2_lexicon_price

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 36
	automation_tick = never

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_cul2_polyglot_lexicon_mod
				years = 10
				mode = replace
			}
			culture = {
				add_cultural_influence = 3
				add_cultural_tradition = 2
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = {
					at_war = no
					gold >= 250
					NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_cul2_polyglot_lexicon_mod }
				}
			}
			add = 12
		}
	}
}

oe_cul2_act_convene_cultural_congress = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_government_generic

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			OR = {
				oe_cul2_any_hybrid_arc_eligible = yes
				oe_cul2_owns_any_cultural_capital = yes
				culture = { cultural_influence >= 25 }
			}
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			in_civil_war = no
			at_war = no
			NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_cul2_congress_cd }
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_cul2_congress_cd
		years = 15
	}

	price = price:oe_cul2_congress_price

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 48
	automation_tick = never

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { oe_cul2_hyb1_eligible = yes }
				set_variable = oe_cul2_hyb1_done
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cul2_hyb.1
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { oe_cul2_hyb2_eligible = yes }
				set_variable = oe_cul2_hyb2_done
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cul2_hyb.2
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { oe_cul2_hyb3_eligible = yes }
				set_variable = oe_cul2_hyb3_done
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cul2_hyb.3
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { oe_cul2_hyb4_eligible = yes }
				set_variable = oe_cul2_hyb4_done
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cul2_hyb.4
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { oe_cul2_hyb5_eligible = yes }
				set_variable = oe_cul2_hyb5_done
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cul2_hyb.5
			}
			else = {
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_cul2_cultural_symposium_mod
					years = 12
					mode = replace
				}
				culture = {
					add_cultural_influence = 5
					add_cultural_tradition = 3
				}
				add_prestige = 8
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = {
					gold >= 300
					OR = {
						oe_cul2_any_hybrid_arc_eligible = yes
						oe_cul2_owns_any_cultural_capital = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 15
		}
	}
}
